## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2017-04-10: Form-of Non-Blocker TRA filed as S-1/A Exhibit 10.4
- 2018-01-17: TRA executed at IPO close between Liberty Oilfield Services Inc. and the Continuing Liberty LLC Unit Holders
- 2018-01-18: IPO-close 8-K files the executed Non-Blocker TRA as Exhibit 10.3

#### Up-C collapse

- 2023-01-31: Liberty Oilfield Services New HoldCo LLC merged into Liberty Energy Inc.; all Class B shares retired and all Liberty LLC Units extinguished; Non-Blocker TRA continues in force on the basis step-ups previously generated by exchanges

#### Payment phase

- 2024: First material cash payment of $5.2M; YE2024 liability $115.7M
- 2025: $40.757M payment in Q1 2025
- 2026: $7.888M payment in Q1 2026; combined-TRA liability $66.87M long-term

## Explanation

Liberty Oilfield Services Inc. (renamed Liberty Energy Inc.) executed two parallel TRAs at its January 17, 2018 Up-C IPO close; this is the Non-Blocker TRA, which obligates the PubCo to pay the Continuing Liberty LLC Unit Holders 85% of cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated when those holders exchanged Liberty LLC Units for Class A common stock (or cash), plus imputed interest and certain other IPO-restructuring basis. The 2020 OneStim acquisition from Schlumberger did not amend the contract, and the January 31, 2023 collapse of the Up-C structure (merger of Liberty Oilfield Services New HoldCo LLC into the PubCo) retired all remaining Liberty LLC Units and Class B shares but left the Non-Blocker TRA in force on the basis already generated by pre-collapse exchanges. Material cash payments began in 2024 and accelerated in 2025-2026 as Liberty's profitability rose and the post-IPO basis step-ups generated realized tax benefits. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the parallel Blocker TRA at `liberty-energy-inc_TRA-2018-01-17-Blocker_summary.qmd`.
